request: 配置 CAN 总线，波特率 500kbps，3 个控制器
config:
```yaml
baudrate: 500000
num_controllers: 3
general:
  dev_error_detect: true
  version_info_api: true
CanController:
  - id: 0
    baudrate: 500000
    propagation_delay: 100
  - id: 1
    baudrate: 500000
    propagation_delay: 100
  - id: 2
    baudrate: 500000
    propagation_delay: 100
```

request: 启用 CAN FD 支持，数据段波特率 2Mbps
config:
```yaml
can_fd_support: true
general:
  dev_error_detect: true
CanController:
  - id: 0
    baudrate: 500000
    data_baudrate: 2000000
    can_fd: true
```

request: 配置 CAN 唤醒支持和错误检测
config:
```yaml
general:
  dev_error_detect: true
  wakeup_support: true
  version_info_api: true
```
